sources.notes: Our own round-trip fixture .docx files (tools/roundtrip --gen-seed output).

Real-world Word document regression fixtures accumulated from ~20 years of Apache POI bug reports. Many are deliberately malformed, oddly-encoded, or edge-case Word output -- exactly the class of 'wild' document issue #88 wants. Only .docx entries are fetched; sibling .doc/.docm files in the same directory are skipped (this project reads OOXML only).
Real Word-authored sample .docx files docx4j ships for its own conversion/merge/inspection demos -- more 'ordinary document' diversity alongside POI's bug-report-driven fixtures.
